claims.explanation: WZ-4002 is a covalent/irreversible EGFR/ERBB2 inhibitor, so selectivity is expected to track with dependence on EGFR/ERBB2 signaling. Lines with activating EGFR or ERBB2 mutations, or with high EGFR/ERBB2 expression and autocrine ligand-driven signaling, should be sensitized, while lines with downstream bypass resistance (KRAS/BRAF/PTEN/PIK3CA mutations) or low receptor expression should be protected.

features.basis: activating EGFR kinase-domain mutations confer sensitivity to EGFR inhibitors
ERBB2 kinase-domain mutations show differential sensitivity to ERBB2 inhibitors
EGFR/ERBB2 dependency and dimerization are the drug's annotated mechanism
ERBB2 overexpression/amplification predicts ERBB2 inhibitor response
downstream RAS activation bypasses EGFR/ERBB2 blockade
downstream MAPK activation bypasses receptor inhibition
loss of PTEN activates PI3K/AKT downstream of ERBB2
activating PI3K mutations bypass upstream receptor dependence
